_conventions: Godot axes, metres. Origin at the base centre (y=0 is the ground), front faces +Z. box collision_size = [x, y, z]; cylinder collision_size = [radius, height]; collision_offset = centre of the shape relative to the prop origin. Generated by work/props/build_manifest.py.

column.notes: Fluted marble column, square plinth and capital. Cylinder uses the plinth half-width.

column_broken.notes: Standing stump plus a fallen drum. A baked ground/shadow card was removed; a thin sliver may remain flat at y=0 under the fallen drum (hidden by the floor).

statue_a.notes: Warrior with sword and round shield on a small plinth. Collision box = plinth footprint, full height.

statue_b.notes: Lunging spearman on a plinth; the spear sticks out to 2.6 m wide. Collision box = plinth footprint.

basalt_spire.notes: Black basalt spire with orange lava cracks (texture). Cylinder = base radius.

temple.notes: Small pedimented temple, red tile roof; 9.0 m wide (X), ~11 m deep (Z). Solid box, no interior.

olive_tree.notes: Regenerated (v2 concept with a solid canopy). Cylinder collision around the trunk; the canopy does not collide.

brazier.notes: Flame geometry was fused to the bowl and has been cut away (colour + above-rim cut); coals remain. Scaled so body + game fire = 1.5 m as in the concept (body 0.97 m). Put the fire at the bowl top, y ~= 0.9 (widest rim section at y = 0.88).

pedestal.notes: Round drum pedestal with key-pattern band, 1.1 m tall; top is a shallow dish. Cylinder.

gate.notes: Two columns and an entablature, walkable opening. Use collision_parts (2 posts + lintel); the single box in collision_size would block the opening.

cypress.notes: Tall narrow cypress. Cylinder = the narrow lower canopy/trunk radius, full height.
